caseReview.independentRationale: s0141 names 愛婿 and 辛廷蔚 only.「瓚女」never appears in chapter Chinese; it is an editorial compound and cannot block certification. Owner correctly refuses to treat p082 as a named daughter record. Compact schema requires at least one name claim on p082, so the supported patch replaces the false alias with the quotable kinship surface「愛婿」from the same unit rather than deleting all name claims as the owner draft proposed.
